description: A sound effect from a description, as an MP3 of 0.5 to 30 seconds; loop true makes one that loops without a seam (ambience, engines, hums). Costs credits: elevenlabs-sfx 1 per 2 seconds; without seconds the model picks the length, the job is held at 30 s and charged for what came back. Look in the free library first: search_assets with type audio. Waits about 45 s, then returns job_id for get_job.

prompt.description: The sound, up to 450 characters: "heavy wooden door creaking open, then slamming shut".

prompt_influence.description: How closely it keeps to the words (0.3 default).

name: generate_sound_effect
title: Generate a sound effect
